race.comment: BE LIVELY (7) latest effort finished last in a Rank Limit - Grade 5 on October 26 over 300m at this track behind MY BOY SONNY beaten 6 lengths (17.57). Can find winning form. LET'S GO CHAMP (8) put in a much better performance last start when in the placings at Traralgon behind Best Dressed (20.45) in a Grade 5. Has the early speed to land on the pace and can stick on. Won at her only start from this draw. Expected to feature again. HAWK MAGIC (3) last start finished 6th over 300m at this track beaten 5 lengths (17.09) behind Magic Thrill in a Grade 5 on October 23. Can feature in the finish. BENGAL BULLET (1) deserves plenty of thought over this journey.
